BiblicalUsage: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish, for I work a work in your days which ye will not believe though a man declare it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God warns the despisers first, because the work He is doing is too great to be laughed away.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
